resolved_source_issues.issue: A sentence calls the divergence of a vector a vector after identifying it as a scalar.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter consistently identifies divergence as scalar.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The live interior-field algebra loses and debates factors of four pi, then briefly says the field scales as one over r.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The complete derivation gives A_r=-(4 pi G rho/3)r and explains the r cubed over r squared scaling.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The lecture gives an uncertain ten-minute through-Earth estimate.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The period and transit times are evaluated from the lecture's own uniform-density oscillator model.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The lecture is uncertain whether the full deflection is twice or half the estimate.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter records the standard general-relativistic result as exactly twice the elementary estimate.

uncertain_sources.note: The rough proton-equivalent density estimate is not repeated numerically; only its intended local-smallness conclusion is retained.
The phrase relative energy is undefined in the question; the response preserves that ambiguity.
The eclipse verification is retained at the level stated in the lecture without adding a historical narrative.
